SDIS1.label: Institutional sign in not working

SDIS1.1.label: Admin/User management issue
SDIS1.1.description: Definition: Use when institutional authentication fails because of an administrator, role or user configuration, or when an admin wants to add a user

SDIS1.2.label: Institution not entitled
SDIS1.2.description: Definition: Use when the institution is recognised but has no valid entitlement.

SDIS1.3.label: Not enough info
SDIS1.3.description: Definition: Use when institutional sign-in fails but the cause is not described.

SDIS1.4.label: Other
SDIS1.4.description: Definition: Use for another institutional authentication issue not listed above.

SDIS1.description: Every ticket in this task has already been classified as 'Institutional sign in not working'. Choose the root cause from this group only. That contact reason means: Use when access through an institution fails, with signals such as SSO, SAML, Shibboleth, institution not found, institution not recognised or remote institutional access, and not for personal subscription
